purpose: Give every MIRROR asset first-class photo and media support so asset lists, cards, search results and detail pages can present a visual, evidence-backed interface without changing asset identity.

identity.content_hash: sha256 required for stored media evidence

ui_contract.asset_card: show the primary photo when present; otherwise show a polished asset-type placeholder, never a broken-image surface
ui_contract.asset_list: support thumbnail-first rows or cards while retaining text searchability and accessibility labels
ui_contract.asset_detail: lead with the primary photo and expose an ordered gallery plus evidence/media metadata
ui_contract.photo_action: an Add photo / Take photo action is available from every asset detail surface
ui_contract.gallery_order: primary first, then user-selected order, then newest media
ui_contract.tap_behavior: open full media/evidence view without losing the asset context

capture_contract.scan_ingestion: media produced during QR/barcode/RFID inventory workflows may be attached to the resolved asset

storage_portability.self_hosted_default: object storage or filesystem evidence store
